cases.label: PrOMMiS Steady Solvent Extraction
cases.request: Build a steady-state PrOMMiS solvent-extraction process with aqueous and organic feeds and separate aqueous and loaded-organic products.

cases.label: PrOMMiS Steady Mixer-Settler Extraction
cases.request: Build a steady-state PrOMMiS mixer-settler extraction stage with aqueous and organic feeds and separate equilibrated aqueous and organic products.

cases.label: PrOMMiS UKy Tutorial Flowsheet PFD
cases.request: Reconstruct the PrOMMiS UKy rare-earth recovery process from the tutorial PFD, preserving the leach, rougher and cleaner solvent-extraction, precipitation, roasting, purge, and product paths.

cases.label: PrOMMiS UKy Costing
cases.request: Build the PrOMMiS UKy rare-earth recovery process from leaching through rougher and cleaner solvent extraction, precipitation, and roasting, then evaluate its process costs.

cases.label: PrOMMiS UKy Flowsheet
cases.request: Build the full PrOMMiS UKy rare-earth recovery flowsheet with leaching, solid-liquid separation, rougher loading, scrubbing and stripping, cleaner extraction, precipitation, roasting, purge streams, and a rare-earth-oxide product.

cases.label: PrOMMiS Simplified UKy Flowsheet
cases.request: Build the simplified PrOMMiS UKy rare-earth recovery flowsheet with leaching, solid-liquid separation, rougher and cleaner solvent-extraction sections, precipitation, roasting, and a rare-earth-oxide product.

cases.label: PrOMMiS UKy UI Flowsheet
cases.request: Build the PrOMMiS UKy rare-earth recovery flowsheet represented in the interactive flowsheet view, from leaching and staged solvent extraction through precipitation and roasting.

cases.label: PrOMMiS Membrane Cascade Flowsheet
cases.request: Build the PrOMMiS multistage diafiltration membrane cascade with feed and diafiltrate distribution, two membrane stages, retentate and permeate recycles, product mixers, precipitation, solids recovery, and a waste outlet.

cases.label: WaterTAP ASM1 Clarifier-Only RAS
cases.request: Build and solve the WaterTAP ASM1 five-reactor train with conventional clarifier-only return activated sludge. Route all R5 effluent to the secondary clarifier, return only clarifier underflow through the RAS pressure boundary, retain a waste-activated-sludge purge, and set direct R5 recycle to zero by continuation. Report NH4-N, NO3-N, soluble inorganic N, RAS ratio, HRT, WAS flow, oxygen transfer, estimated aeration energy, and hydraulic closure.

cases.label: Methanol-Water NRTL Partial Condensation
cases.request: Build and solve a two-stage methanol-water purification train at 1 atm using ideal-vapor, temperature-dependent NRTL-liquid VLE. Feed 100 mol/s at 90 mol% methanol, remove a water-rich liquid in the first flash, partially condense its vapor in a second equilibrium stage, and report product purity, methanol recovery, cooling duty, both water-rich cuts, and molar balance closure.

cases.label: IDAES Steady Closed Feedwater Heater
cases.request: Build and solve the native IDAES steady closed feedwater heater with IAPWS95 properties, desuperheating, condensation, drain cooling, and cascade-drain mixing. Determine extraction-steam flow from the saturation constraint and report feedwater heat gain, each zone duty, extraction ratio, outlet enthalpies, and duty closure.

cases.label: WaterTAP ASM1 Sludge Dewatering Unit
cases.request: Build and solve the official WaterTAP DewateringUnit with ASM1 properties on the BSM2 waste-sludge feed. Produce clarified overflow and concentrated sludge cake, and report hydraulic recovery, TSS capture, filtrate TSS, cake dry-solids fraction, electricity, vessel volume, and hydraulic and particulate balance closure.
